name: devices-mcp
description: Home security and IoT orchestration MCP server. Dual-architecture: individual device MCP servers + unified web-sota dashboard. Supports Tapo cameras, Ring doorbells, Nest Protect, Philips Hue lighting, Netatmo weather, Shelly devices, USB webcams.

dual_architecture.note: Individual device MCP servers + unified web-sota dashboard

dashboard.note: Vite + React SPA at /app/ with dark mode

portmanteau_tools.note: ~20 consolidated management tools from 40+ atomic tools

health_supervisor.note: Connection supervisor with 60s polling, circuit breakers, auto-reconnect

log_management.note: Log viewer, rotation, compression, cleanup, AI analysis
